cross_discipline_units.title: Termination of Pregnancy
cross_discipline_units.cross_discipline_note: Abortion is federally decriminalized in Canada but gestational-age limits, funding, and access vary provincially/territorially; ELOM may separately cover the underlying consent/capacity framework more generally. PRIMARY_OWNER not finalized here.

cross_discipline_units.title: Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome
cross_discipline_units.cross_discipline_note: Overlaps Endocrinology (E, completed), which may cover the hyperandrogenism/insulin-resistance mechanism in more depth; GY's content is the menstrual/reproductive/fertility angle. PRIMARY_OWNER not finalized here.

cross_discipline_units.title: Sexually Transmitted Infections (Gynecologic Presentation)
cross_discipline_units.cross_discipline_note: Overlaps Infectious Diseases and Public Health and Preventive Medicine (both not yet mapped), which may cover reportable-disease/partner-notification obligations in more depth. PRIMARY_OWNER not finalized here.

cross_discipline_units.title: Gynecologic Surgical Site Infections
cross_discipline_units.cross_discipline_note: Overlaps General and Thoracic Surgery (GS, completed), which covers general surgical-site infection management. PRIMARY_OWNER not finalized here.

cross_discipline_units.title: Sexual Abuse and Assault
cross_discipline_units.cross_discipline_note: Mandatory-reporting/forensic-examination protocols are provincially/territorially administered and may overlap ELOM's more general consent/reporting content. PRIMARY_OWNER/DISTINCT_CONTEXT not finalized here.

cross_discipline_units.title: Urinary Incontinence (Gynecologic)
cross_discipline_units.cross_discipline_note: MCC objective 47-2 is not gynecology-specific and is shared with Urology (not yet mapped). PRIMARY_OWNER not finalized here.
